nodes.name: ecc pre:edit-write:suggest-compact hook
nodes.description: everything-claude-code's compact-suggestion hook, superseded in this repo by rhize-context-manager's context-window-monitor.js for sessions using a verified-model window table instead of sniffing the model id for a '[1m]' marker.

nodes.name: @rhize/skill-forge
nodes.description: npm CLI (Rhize-Media/skill-forge) providing the SkillOpt evolve/safety gate that refinement-pipeline's /skill-refine run step and third-party skill intake depend on.

nodes.name: rhize-skill CLI
nodes.description: Canonical Rhize-Media/procedural-memory runtime. The procedural-memory skill uses its registry-gated recall/run/promote/verify commands, while Functionize uses only its mining, inert proposal-generation, and review commands.

nodes.name: humanizer (humanizer plugin)
nodes.description: Third-party plugin whose SKILL.md sits at the plugin root (not under skills/*/SKILL.md), so it isn't inventoried as a skill node by build_local_skill_map.py's third-party scan; rewrites AI-sounding text to read more naturally.

nodes.description: everything-claude-code agent; fixes Java/Maven/Gradle build failures.

nodes.name: ecc:build-error-resolver (agent)
nodes.description: everything-claude-code general build/TypeScript error resolution agent.
A build/compile step failed (bundler, compiler, or `npm run build`-style failure)
A static type check failed (tsc, mypy, or equivalent)

nodes.name: sentry (sentry-plugin-marketplace)
nodes.description: Official Sentry plugin (sentry-instrument, sentry-workflow, sentry-debug-issue, sentry-feature-setup, sentry-get-started skills) providing general-purpose SDK setup and API reference. rhize-devflow's sentry-instrumentation skill covers only Rhize house conventions (captureException/startSpan/logger.fmt patterns, sensitive-data handling) on top of it.

nodes.name: sanity (sanity-agent-toolkit)
nodes.description: Official Sanity plugin (sanity-best-practices, content-modeling-best-practices, portable-text-serialization, seo-aeo-best-practices skills, plus deploy-schema/typegen commands) providing general Sanity API documentation. rhize-devflow's sanity-development skill covers only Rhize house conventions (named exports, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE queries, model-what-things-ARE) on top of it.

nodes.name: ecc:browser-qa (skill)
nodes.description: everything-claude-code's browser QA skill — the active browser specialist chrome-devtools-mcp defers general DevTools-protocol API documentation to. rhize-devflow's chrome-devtools-mcp skill supplies only the tool-name/parameter mechanics its own browser-qa command calls.

nodes.name: superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch (skill)
nodes.description: Maintained Superpowers branch-finishing resource supplying environment detection, detached-worktree handling, rejected-push safeguards, and cleanup mechanics. rhize-devflow's completed-branch-promotion adds the Rhize-specific authorized dev/main PR and deployment sequence.
